migrationPolicy: Known-field copy from legacy schema 30; unknown top-level keys are preserved in migration.preservedUnknownKeys; unresolved source semantics are never guessed.
validationContract: creation stat/element container presence when configured
player.stats is an object with non-negative integer str/dex/tgh/vital
world.position is an object with integer floorId/x/y when present
idle.offline is an object; elapsed/accrued/cap are non-negative integers and accruedSeconds <= accrualCapSeconds when cap exists

sourceEvidence.goldField: state.gold is an existing runtime state field; fresh-state history records source-backed initial Gold separately from defaultPlayer.h
sourceEvidence.caution: current canonical freshState keeps structural gold=0 until the create-character transaction is wired; initial creation value is not silently hardcoded here.
sourceEvidence.creation: Creation input is source-backed; values are only applied by the new-player creation runtime after explicit player selection.

persistenceBoundary.rule: shape validation only; contents remain source/product-policy driven and are not inferred
